appTag: Moses and Joshua · From the Exodus to the Promised Land
docTitle: The Way — Moses and Joshua | Walk the Exodus and Canaan on a Map
metaDesc: From slavery in Egypt through the Red Sea, Mount Sinai and forty years in the wilderness, across the Jordan into the promised land. Walk 40 scenes of Moses and Joshua on a Bible map.
mapAria: The route of the Exodus on a map of Egypt, the Sinai Peninsula and Canaan
introTag: The way of Moses and Joshua, from the Exodus to the promised land
introLead: Walk the map and follow the road from slavery to freedom, from the wilderness to the promised land.
introF1: Follow the places, from Egypt through the Red Sea, Mount Sinai and the wilderness to Canaan
introF3: Hear the story read aloud, and read the words God and his people spoke
landStep2: Read the story and the texts on the card, and press ▶ to hear it read aloud
landStep4: Gather God's words in the '{words}' tab and revisit the scenes you have walked with '{quiz}'
wordsIntro: The words God spoke along the way of Moses and Joshua, gathered in the order of the journey. Every saying is a fresh rendering of the original meaning in today's language.
odoTitle: Distance Israel has walked up to this scene (estimated road distance between places; steps at a 75 cm stride)
endLead: From the brick kilns of Egypt to the covenant at Shechem — thank you for walking with us.
blessing:
May the Lord bless you and keep you.
May the Lord make his face shine on you and be gracious to you.
May the Lord turn his face toward you and give you peace. (Num 6:24–26)
May the one who sent manna every day in the wilderness feed you today, and the one who went ahead in the pillar of cloud guide your way.
lessons:
Rescue first, obedience in response|God first brought his enslaved people out, and only then gave his word at Sinai. The commandments are not the price of being saved but the life of those who have been saved. (Exod 20:2)
Manna every day|In the wilderness only one day's manna could be gathered. God taught them that people do not live on bread alone but on every word from his mouth. (Deut 8:3)
Choose life|Grumbling and unbelief kept a whole generation in the wilderness. God still sets life and death before us and says: choose life, and love him. (Deut 30:19–20)
gospelBridge: On the night of the Passover, the blood of the lamb on the doorposts made death pass over. In the wilderness, whoever looked at the bronze serpent lived. Jesus said these things pointed to him: just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up. (John 3:14)
invite:
If the story of God you met on this road has stayed with you, come and meet Jesus, who stands at the center of that story. Walk 'The Footsteps of Jesus' from the beginning, and visit a church near you. May you meet God in worship and in his word, be adopted as his child, and know the joy of calling God 'Father.' (Rom 8:15)
He is still standing at the door, waiting for you. (Rev 3:20)
seekerHead: For those who don’t yet know him
